market.summary: Overnight cues are mixed: Wall Street rose (Nasdaq +1.2%) and Asia is up, led by a 6% jump in Korea, but GIFT Nifty was slightly lower early and Brent is back near $115.5 on renewed Gulf tension. The good news at home is that foreign investors turned buyers on Tuesday (+₹4,240 Cr). The Fed decides tonight (IST) and a 'hawkish hold' is the base case, so small caps may stay jumpy into the evening.

points.text: US close Tuesday: S&P 500 +0.6%, Nasdaq +1.18%; GIFT Nifty -0.16% at 6:42 IST.
Asia this morning: Kospi +6.2% (SK Hynix ~+9%), Shanghai +0.7%, Hang Seng +0.2%, Topix +0.4%.
Brent +1.5% to about $115.50 after a report that the US told Gulf states to prepare for a short military campaign; WTI ~$101.
Provisional flows 27 Oct: FIIs net bought ₹4,240 Cr, DIIs net sold ₹1,250 Cr - a reversal from Monday (FII -₹1,462 Cr).
Nifty closed flat at 22,750 on 27 Oct; Midcap +1%, Smallcap +2.7%; Bank Nifty -392 points.
Fed decision tonight (IST): expected to hold rates despite hot September inflation; some see risk of a hike.

market.watch: Brent above $117 or a hawkish Fed tonight would weigh on small caps; the rupee was ~95.15/$ on Monday.

GROWW.summary: No new news since last evening. Groww closed 27 Oct at 186.57, below the 188.75 stop for the third time, so the plan's exit stands. One possible support for the sector: capital-market stocks rose on Tuesday on reports of possible LTCG / STT changes (BSE +2%), but nothing is decided and Groww did not join the move.

points.text: Capital-market stocks rose on 27 Oct on reports of possible LTCG tax / STT changes; BSE gained more than 2% (no details on rates or timing).
Close ₹186.57 vs stop ₹188.75 and entry ₹200.80: -1.18R (-7.1%); 21-day EMA 190.28 and 63-day EMA 192.16 are both above the price.
BSE Ltd was among the Nifty 50's top gainers today, so capital-market sentiment was not the drag.
No exchange filing since the 16 Oct call transcript; no bulk or block deals in the last 10 days.

GROWW.watch: Exit per the plan; tell Claude the exit price so the trade is marked CLOSED.

The stock lagged Tuesday's small-cap rally but is well above its stop.

points.text: Reported guidance: FY27 revenue growth 25-40%, EBITDA margin ~18%, PAT margin ~10%; capacity expansion in India and the UAE aimed at ₹600-650 Cr peak revenue by FY28 (publisher's report, not a direct quote).
Earnings call transcript filed 27 Oct, 16:42 IST (content not read tonight).
Nifty Smallcap +2.7% today while Sejal fell: it lagged the bounce on the day of the add.

SEJALLTD.watch: Hold above the 846.50 result-day low; a close under 838.03 is the exit; +1R is 930.23.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: Hold above the 727.89 entry would keep it in profit; +1R 793.67, stop 662.11.

ORIENTELEC.summary: No new news since last evening. Q2 growth was strong but metal and crude-linked costs are not fully passed on; Brent back near $115.5 this morning keeps that input-cost risk alive.

points.text: Brent rose 1.5% to about $115.50 this morning (crude-linked plastics and packaging are an input cost).
Q2 FY27: revenue ₹879 Cr (+25.2%), EBITDA ₹57 Cr (+49.7%, margin 6.5%, +106 bps), PAT ₹27.1 Cr (+124%); profit was 14% lower than Q1's ₹31.5 Cr.
Fans and appliances ₹550 Cr (+24.9%, BLDC fans +26%); lighting & switchgear ₹329 Cr (+25.7%).
Price hikes of 3-6% in Q2 and about 3% more in October cover roughly 80% of the cost rise in fans and 90% in appliances; management aims for double-digit EBITDA margins over 4-6 quarters.

ORIENTELEC.watch: Copper / aluminium and crude; stop 171.27 below the 173.00 result-day low; +1R 203.61.
